Choose the next available operation using the recorded outcomes. execution.results.status checks the selected retained inputs and existing comparison records. execution.results.collect calculates the fixed comparison and prepares exactly the requested return. Both operations take an empty argument object. The calculation uses the bound local limits of 20 GiB memory and 4 GiB scratch, with no wall-time budget. Choose between the available operations as the evidence warrants; no operation order is prescribed.

Preserve native measurements, model assumptions, units, coordinates, valid partial results and specific failure qualifications. Measured zero, unavailable, not tested, failed and incompatible are distinct. The scientific parent interprets the returned comparison; model energy or pairing change alone does not establish experimental stability, biological importance or function.

A completed status action does not complete the requested comparison delivery. The configured controller owns continuation. Validated completion of the original requested delivery sets future expected credit to exact zero through the existing practical endpoint, preserving the final actual gain and prior observations. Select the next action and constrained interpretations through the supplied typed response contract; recorded facts are populated automatically. Tool-specific and resource instructions are available through knowledge.search, knowledge.entry and knowledge.read. The tool_knowledge context identifies the run-frozen library. Retrieve sections when useful; these instructions do not select work, supply scientific evidence or add execution capabilities. Use the actual tool schemas and caller-owned configuration for execution. Knowledge reads use line coordinates, not scientific source-byte anchors. No manual read is mandatory. The launch_instruction_library context gives its identity. Select any relevant sections from one or several entries; pass the returned selection as launch_instructions in the child assignment. selected_launch_instructions contains exact sections already selected for this assignment. Instructions describe ways to work; they do not select resources, enable tools, override caller constraints, establish current availability or supply scientific evidence. Inventory and fresh observations remain separate. No instruction read or selection is mandatory.
